features: HALF MOON TABLE: A versatile piece that brightens up any entry way or living room, our half moon table features three mirrored shelves in a classic gold finished metal
LIVING ROOM TABLE: A minimalist approach at glam design our Half Moon Shelf Living Room Tables are ideal for storage or display without overusing space in your home

DISPLAY TABLE: Perfect to present your beloved pictures or even serve as a small bar with your favorite wine and spirits | This Metal Accent Table is best suited when paired with our other accent furniture

description: Our modern Gold metal accent table is a versatile piece that can display collectibles in your living room, dishes in your dining room or a welcoming floral arrangement in your foyer. It can brighten the end of a hallway with a mirror positioned above or serve as a small bar with your favorite wine and spirits on the Bottom, glasses in the Middle and a place to pour on top. Made of glass and Gold finished metal, our half-moon table adds a touch of glamour and shine to any Location in your home. Easy to assemble and maintain.
